entries.title: Job 21:1
segments: ¶Then Job made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 21:2
segments: Give attention with care to my words; and let this be your comfort.

entries.title: Job 21:3
segments: Let me say what is in my mind, and after that, go on making sport of me.

entries.title: Job 21:4
segments: As for me, is my outcry against man? is it then to be wondered at if my spirit is troubled?

entries.title: Job 21:5
segments: Take note of me and be full of wonder, put your hand on your mouth.

entries.title: Job 21:6
segments: At the very thought of it my flesh is shaking with fear.

entries.title: Job 21:7
segments: ¶Why is life given to the evil-doers? why do they become old and strong in power?

entries.title: Job 21:8
segments: Their children are ever with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

entries.title: Job 21:9
segments: Their houses are free from fear, and the rod of God does not come on them.

entries.title: Job 21:10
segments: Their ox is ready at all times to give seed; their cow gives birth, without dropping her young.

entries.title: Job 21:11
segments: They send out their young ones like a flock, and their children have pleasure in the dance,

entries.title: Job 21:12
segments: They make songs to the instruments of music, and are glad at the sound of the pipe.

entries.title: Job 21:13
segments: Their days come to an end without trouble, and suddenly they go down to the underworld.

entries.title: Job 21:14
segments: Though they said to God, Go away from us, for we have no desire for the knowledge of your ways.

entries.title: Job 21:15
segments: What is the Ruler of all, that we may give him worship? and what profit is it to us to make prayer to him?

entries.title: Job 21:16
segments: Truly, is not their well-being in their power? (The purpose of the evil-doers is far from me.)

entries.title: Job 21:17
segments: ¶How frequently is the light of the evil-doers put out, or does trouble come on them? how frequently does his wrath take them with cords?

entries.title: Job 21:18
segments: How frequently are they as dry stems before the wind, or as grass taken away by the storm-wind?

entries.title: Job 21:19
segments: You say, God keeps punishment stored up for his children. Let him send it on the man himself, so that he may have the punishment of it!

entries.title: Job 21:20
segments: Let his eyes see his trouble, and let him be full of the wrath of the Ruler of all!

entries.title: Job 21:21
segments: For what interest has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is ended?

entries.title: Job 21:22
segments: Is anyone able to give teaching to God? for he is the judge of those who are on high.

entries.title: Job 21:23
segments: One comes to his end in complete well-being, full of peace and quiet:

entries.title: Job 21:24
segments: His buckets are full of milk, and there is no loss of strength in his bones.

entries.title: Job 21:25
segments: And another comes to his end with a bitter soul, without ever tasting good.

entries.title: Job 21:26
segments: Together they go down to the dust, and are covered by the worm.

entries.title: Job 21:27
segments: ¶See, I am conscious of your thoughts, and of your violent purposes against me;

entries.title: Job 21:28
segments: For you say, Where is the house of the ruler, and where is the tent of the evil-doer?

entries.title: Job 21:29
segments: Have you not put the question to the travellers, and do you not take note of their experience?

entries.title: Job 21:30
segments: How the evil man goes free in the day of trouble, and has salvation in the day of wrath?

entries.title: Job 21:31
segments: Who will make his way clear to his face? and if he has done a thing, who gives him punishment for it?

entries.title: Job 21:32
segments: He is taken to his last resting-place, and keeps watch over it.

entries.title: Job 21:33
segments: The earth of the valley covering his bones is sweet to him, and all men come after him, as there were unnumbered before him.

entries.title: Job 21:34
segments: Why then do you give me comfort with words in which there is no profit, when you see that there is nothing in your answers but deceit?
